product_launches.description: FarEye launched PILOT, an AI product composed of 11 specialized agents that autonomously manage end-to-end last-mile dispatch tasks such as route planning, driver management, failed delivery recovery, and invoice reconciliation, aiming to cut dispatcher effort from 10 hours to about 60 minutes.

overview_description.description: FarEye’s AI-powered functionality optimizes end-to-end deliveries and provides recommendations driven by aggregation of insights. It empowers enterprises to gain real-time visibility, excel in the last mile, and deliver customer delight. FarEye has the vision to use aggregated data and real-time feedback to drive autonomous deliveries with autonomous vehicles and drones.  With 17 Gartner mentions, DHL, Hilti, UPS, Gordon Foods, Zalora, and 150 plus customers have laid trust in FarEye as their partner of choice across 30 countries. FarEye is empowering global enterprises to shrink delivery time by up to 27%, increase courier productivity by up to 15%, eliminate risks by up to 57%, and ensure operational excellence

about_short_description.short_description: FarEye is a low-code, Intelligent Delivery Management Platform designed for a better delivery experience for everyone.

product.name: FarEye Intelligent Delivery Management Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for planning, orchestrating, executing, tracking, and analyzing delivery operations across enterprise logistics networks.

product.name: FarEye Route
product.description: Route planning software that creates optimized delivery routes using factors such as traffic, service-level agreements, vehicle capacity, and driver skills.

product.name: FarEye Track
product.description: Last-mile tracking software that provides shipment visibility, delivery status updates, estimated arrival information, and customer-facing tracking.

product.name: FarEye Experience
product.description: Delivery experience software for offering delivery options, branded tracking, proactive notifications, and customer communication throughout the order-to-door journey.

product.name: FarEye Ship
product.description: Multi-carrier shipping software for selecting carriers, comparing rates and performance, allocating shipments, and managing parcel delivery decisions.

product.name: FarEye Execute
product.description: Delivery execution software for dispatch, load preparation, driver workflows, proof of delivery, exception handling, and real-time operational control.
